entries.name: HRV readiness support
entries.summary: Heart rate variability can support recovery readiness when evaluated with trend context and other recovery signals.
missingEvidenceQuestions: Does HRV agree with sleep and fatigue evidence?

entries.name: HRV uncertainty
entries.summary: HRV should not be treated as a standalone readiness decision without supporting evidence.
entries.coreRule: Core must explain HRV limitations when supporting evidence is missing.
